_meta.description: Stack-wide base for every logs-dxdfir.* stream: the router default_pipeline, no replicas (one node), the 2000-field backstop, labels.* (the routing key, the case and item from the path, the pipeline-error drain), and the cross-lane scalar backstops (Level, PID, PPID) whose type must not depend on which lane's record lands in a stream first. Per-lane field models live in the sibling logs-dxdfir@<lane> components; this file carries nothing lane-specific.
